about: Per-file counts from scripts/design-token-scan.js (#16). Counts only fall: a higher count, or a count in a file with no entry, fails. A lower count fails until it's recorded with `npm run design-token-scan -- --update`. Entries are never added, except that an entry follows a file moved or renamed verbatim in the same PR, and a <style> block moved verbatim into a stylesheet takes its counts along.

patterns.color-literal: Raw colors: hex, rgb(), hsl(), and the other color functions, and named colors in color properties
patterns.theme-branching: Theme branching outside the token output: [data-theme] and [data-scheme] selectors, prefers-color-scheme, the data-theme attribute and dataset.theme, and comparisons with 'dark' or 'light'
patterns.runtime-style: Runtime <style> creation: createElement('style') and markup strings with <style
patterns.style-attribute: style= attributes in HTML and markup strings, and setAttribute('style')
patterns.undefined-var: var() with no fallback of a property nothing defines: no token, stylesheet, or script, and for an HTML page, not the page itself
patterns.unregistered-read: getPropertyValue() of a custom property the token output doesn't register with @property, or of a computed name
patterns.gradient-text: Gradient text: a rule with background-clip: text
patterns.hard-shadow: box-shadow with a nonzero offset and zero blur
patterns.one-sided-border: A one-sided border of 2px or more
patterns.transition-all: transition: all, or a transition with no property, reading var() of a duration or easing token as timing
patterns.px-font-size: A px font size: font-size and font in CSS and style writes, canvas fonts, and Chart.js font sizes
patterns.alias-use: var() of a legacy name (legacy.aliases in design/quiet-atlas.tokens.json)
